needle.en: In the 1998 PNAS study that first recovered plague DNA from the dental pulp of French plague-grave skeletons, how many of the twelve suspected 'plague teeth' yielded the Yersinia pestis pla sequence, and how many of the negative-control teeth did?

When Taubenberger and colleagues first characterised the 1918 'Spanish' influenza virus in 1997, which five coding regions did they sequence fragments of, and what subtype and lineage did the sequences indicate?

Three roughly 1,000-year-old mycobacterial genomes from Peruvian skeletons settled whether tuberculosis was present in the Americas before European contact. Which animal-adapted lineage were the ancient strains most closely related to, and what did the same study estimate for the age of the M. tuberculosis complex?

A high-coverage Yersinia pestis genome from a sixth-century burial near Munich was published in 2016. What coverage was achieved, and what did comparison with an earlier lower-coverage Justinianic genome from the same region reveal?
What did the ~3800-year-old Yersinia pestis genomes from the Samara region change about the accepted timing of flea-borne bubonic plague?
The Justinianic Plague is routinely credited with killing tens of millions and helping end antiquity. What did the 2019 PNAS multi-proxy reassessment by Mordechai and colleagues actually find?

How many near-complete variola virus genomes were reconstructed from Viking Age northern European remains in the 2020 Science study, and how do they relate to the variola viruses circulating before eradication?

A 1912 measles virus genome was used to date the split between measles virus and rinderpest virus. What divergence date did the analysis give, and why does that date matter for the earliest possible establishment of measles in humans?

needle.sv: Hur många mikrobiella genom lyckades forskarna sätta ihop från de åtta autentiserade palaeofekalieproverna från sydvästra USA och Mexiko, och hur stor andel av de säkraste tarmgenomen var tidigare obeskrivna arter?

needle.en: Medieval Winchester produced the first ancient Mycobacterium leprae genome from a non-human host. How many samples were screened, what coverage did the genomes reach, and what was the key phylogenetic relationship?

needle.sv: Vad visade de fyra treponemgenomen från nästan 2 000 år gamla mänskliga kvarlevor i Brasilien om treponemsjukdomarnas ursprung, och vilken underart låg de närmast?

needle.en: The 1994 PNAS mtDNA study of European, African and Indian cattle argued for two independent domestications. How did the two mitochondrial lineages map onto the taurine/zebu split, and how old was the estimated divergence?

In the 1997 Science paper that first used mitochondrial control-region sequences to date dog domestication, how many wolves and dogs were sampled, and what origin date did the sequence divergence suggest?

The 2003 Science study of ancient maize DNA targeted three genes controlling plant architecture, storage protein synthesis and starch production. By when were modern-type alleles present, and at which point was selection apparently still incomplete?

What did the 2009 ancient-DNA study of nuclear coat-colour genes conclude about when coat-colour variation appeared in horses, and what did the authors infer from that about the timing of domestication?
What evidence did the 2016 Science study of a Neolithic Irish dog genome and 59 ancient dogs use to argue for a dual origin of dogs, and what divergence date did it report?

needle.sv: Przewalskis häst kallas ofta världens sista äkta vildhäst. Vad visade de 42 forntida hästgenomen från 2018, varav 20 från Botai, om den saken — och hur mycket Botai-släktskap finns i tamhästar?

needle.en: The 2019 analysis of 67 ancient Near Eastern cattle genomes found a Bronze Age shift. What was introgressing, roughly when, and why did the authors conclude the process was male-driven?

Palaeogenomic work on 28 archaeological grape seeds from France found one seed that matched a modern cultivar exactly. Which cultivar, what was the seed's date, and how long a period of vegetative propagation does that imply?

needle.sv: Hur många forntida hästgenom byggde 2021 års Nature-studie på, var placerade den tamhästens hemtrakt, och vilka två gener pekades ut som mål för stark selektion?

needle.en: Chickens are often said to have been domesticated in China or the Indus Valley some 8,000-10,000 years ago. What did the 2022 PNAS assessment of ~600 sites in 89 countries conclude instead?

Domestic cats are commonly assumed to have spread into Europe with Neolithic farmers. What did the 2025 Science analysis of 87 ancient and modern cat genomes find about when and from where they actually arrived?

Eight female Texas pumas were released into Florida in 1995 to rescue the remnant Florida panther population. What did the 2010 assessment report for population size, heterozygosity and the remaining problems?
What fraction of their genome are mountain gorillas typically homozygous across, and what did the 2015 Science study say this inbreeding had done to their deleterious variation?

needle.sv: Vad visade uppföljningen av den naturliga invandringen till den svårt inavlade skandinaviska vargstammen om avkommans framgång, och vilken mekanism föreslog författarna?

needle.en: Channel Island foxes have among the lowest genetic diversity of any mammal, yet all six island populations persist. What explanation did the 2018 study give, and what management warning followed from it?

The Isle Royale wolves are the textbook case of inbreeding depression. What did whole-genome sequencing identify as the genetic mechanism, and why is that relevant to the wolves later translocated there?

Analysis of 60 genomes from six ibex species and the domestic goat produced an apparently contradictory result about mutation load in Alpine ibex. What were the two opposing signals, and what population size threshold did the authors flag?
Kyriazis, Wayne and Lohmueller's 2021 simulations produced a counterintuitive recommendation about where to source migrants for a genetic rescue. What was it, and what is the reasoning?
Some genomic studies have argued conservation should manage functional genetic variation rather than genome-wide variation. What position did Kardos and colleagues take in their 2021 PNAS paper?
With roughly ten animals left, the vaquita would seem doomed by inbreeding. What did whole-genome sequencing of 20 vaquitas and the accompanying simulations conclude, and why?

needle.sv: Hur mycket ökade den realiserade genetiska belastningen hos den skandinaviska vargstammen under fem generationers inavel, och hur många genom byggde slutsatsen på?

needle.en: The IUCN Guidelines on Reintroductions were used in 2014 to build a candidate-screening framework for de-extinction. How many questions does the framework pose, and which three extinct taxa were used as worked examples?

needle.sv: Bucardon, den pyreneiska stenbocken, kallas ofta det första utdöda djur som återuppväckts genom kloning 2003. Vad hände egentligen med den klonade ungen, och hur många embryon och mottagardjur krävdes?

needle.en: What did the 2017 prioritisation analysis of de-extinction candidates from New Zealand and New South Wales conclude about the effect of resurrected species on extant threatened species?

Passenger pigeons had surprisingly low genetic diversity for the most abundant bird in North America. What did the 2017 genomic study attribute this to, and what earlier explanation for their rapid extinction did it contradict?

The thylacine and canids are the classic case of mammalian convergent evolution. What did the 2018 thylacine genome say about the molecular basis of that convergence, and about the species' demography before European arrival?
How many northern white rhinoceros individuals are represented in the induced pluripotent stem cell bank reported in 2021, and what reprogramming method was used?

How many species were represented in the San Diego Zoo Frozen Zoo living cell collection as analysed in 2023, what share of IUCN Threatened amphibians, birds, mammals and reptiles is that, and how far could sampling within existing zoo collections raise it?

needle.sv: Vad var det egentliga nya i att Przewalskis häst klonades från nedfrysta celler, och varför valdes just den individ vars celler användes?

needle.en: In 2025 a biotechnology company announced it had resurrected the dire wolf. What did the animals actually consist of, according to the anatomists' commentary published in The Anatomical Record?

A 2025 welfare-ethics analysis of the engineered dire-wolf-like canids used a specific animal welfare framework and identified a conceptual problem with the project. Which framework, and what was the problem?
The BioRescue consortium's programme for the northern white rhinoceros rests on three legs. What are they, and which milestones had actually been reached as of the 2026 review?
In the 1985 paper that opened up ancient human DNA, how many Egyptian mummies were screened, which one actually worked, and what was in the clone?
Which specimen produced the first Neandertal DNA sequence, and what did the 1997 paper conclude from it?
How much DNA actually survived in the Tyrolean Iceman, and what did his mitochondrial type turn out to be?
Before nuclear data existed, how big was the sample used to argue against a Neandertal mtDNA contribution to early modern humans, and what exactly could it rule out?
What did the first ancient DNA test of lactase persistence in Neolithic Europeans find, and which hypothesis did it support?
What fraction of late central European hunter-gatherers carried mitochondrial types that are rare in central Europeans today?
How much sequence, and from how many individuals, made up the 2010 draft Neandertal genome — and what was the key comparative result?
What did the first complete mitochondrial genome from Denisova Cave show about the age of that lineage?
The 2012 high-coverage Denisovan genome relied on a new lab method. What coverage did it reach, and what did it say about Denisovan genetic diversity?

needle.sv: Vad visade egentligen de första skandinaviska stenåldersgenomen om bönderna jämfört med jägarna-samlarna?

needle.en: How many streams of Asian gene flow did the 2012 continent-wide genotype study of Native Americans identify, and how were they distributed?
How old is the Tianyuan Cave individual, what was actually sequenced from him, and where does he sit relative to present-day populations?
What did the high-quality Altai Neanderthal genome reveal about the woman's parents?
How do we know the Neanderthal gene flow into the Ust'-Ishim individual's ancestors was recent relative to when he lived?

needle.sv: Hur kommer det sig att tibetaner klarar den låga syrehalten på hög höjd — stämmer det att det kommer från denisovaner?

needle.en: What are the three ancestral populations proposed for present-day Europeans in 2014, and what was the unexpected component inside the farmers?

needle.sv: Hur mycket av snörkeramikernas arv kommer egentligen från jamnajafolket på stäppen?

needle.en: Which sequenced modern human carries the most Neanderthal ancestry, how much, and how recent was the admixture in his family?

needle.sv: Hade istidens européer mer neandertal-DNA än vad vi har idag?

needle.en: Did gene flow between modern humans and Neanderthals only run one way?
When did Aboriginal Australian and Papuan ancestors diverge from each other, and when did they split from Eurasians?

needle.sv: När skildes de första moderna människopopulationerna åt, enligt de forntida sydafrikanska genomen?

needle.en: What did the first substantial set of ancient African genomes change about the picture of African population structure?
Was the Bell Beaker phenomenon spread by migration or by cultural diffusion?
What is an 'Ancient Beringian', and what does the Upward Sun River genome do to the Beringian standstill model?
How do the Neanderthal and Denisovan Y chromosomes relate to ours, and why is that phylogeny strange?

needle.sv: Vad hittade man egentligen när man DNA-testade de gravlagda i Newgrange?

needle.en: What did the Chagyrskaya Cave genomes show about how a Neanderthal community was organised?
How does the ERAP2 result from Black Death samples connect a past epidemic to present-day disease risk?

In the 1984 Nature paper that founded ancient DNA — the first genetic data ever recovered from an extinct species — how much mitochondrial sequence was obtained from the quagga, and how far did it differ from a mountain zebra?
Twenty years after the first quagga sequences, a multi-individual study revisited the animal. How many quaggas were sampled, and when did the quagga diverge from the plains zebra?
The 2004 Science study of Beringian steppe bison is usually cited against the overkill hypothesis. What is the actual chronological argument it makes?
When did bison first enter North America, according to the combined palaeontological and palaeogenomic study of 2017, and how many dispersal waves were identified?

needle.sv: Vad visade forntida DNA om visentens (Bison bonasus) ursprung, och vad har grottmålningar med saken att göra?
När skildes grottbjörnens (Ursus spelaeus) och brunbjörnens linjer enligt DNA-studien från 2001, och vilket material byggde slutsatsen på?

needle.en: Why were ancient DNA libraries long depleted of molecules shorter than 40 bp, and what did fixing that make possible at Sima de los Huesos?
What did the 2017 sabretooth mitogenomics paper establish about the divergence between Smilodon and Homotherium, and about how long Homotherium persisted in Europe?
How old is the Smilodon populator specimen that yielded a draft nuclear genome, and what does that make it?

needle.sv: Jättehjorten (Megaloceros giganteus) kallas ofta "irländsk älg". Vilken nu levande hjort är den närmast släkt med, enligt Lister med medarbetare 2005?

needle.en: How late did the giant deer survive, and where — and what does that date do to the standard end-Pleistocene extinction story for the species?
In the 1996 study of Mylodon darwinii, what fraction of the extracted DNA was actually sloth, and what did the phylogeny imply about arboreality in sloths?
Ancient faeces resisted PCR until 1998. What chemical trick unlocked them, and what did the Gypsum Cave coprolite reveal about vegetation change?
The 2003 Science paper that launched sedimentary ancient DNA sampled two very different settings. What was recovered from each?

Macrofossil surveys put the extinction of mammoth and horse in northwestern North America at 15,000-13,000 cal yr BP. What did sedimentary DNA from interior Alaska change about that, and why does it matter for the overkill debate?
The mammoth steppe is popularly described as a grassland. What did the first large-scale circumpolar plant metabarcoding study of Arctic sediments find instead?

The 2021 circumpolar environmental-genomics study of 535 permafrost and lake sediment samples reported two very late survival dates. What were they, and what did the same study conclude about the human role?
How old is the Kap København environmental DNA record from North Greenland, and which animals and trees did it place there?
What were the age and coverage of the Middle Pleistocene horse genome published in 2013, and by how much did it move the origin of the genus Equus?
Where were modern domestic horses domesticated according to the 2021 study of 273 ancient genomes, and which two genes showed strong selection?
How much sequence did the 2008 woolly mammoth nuclear genome paper report, and what did it say about the mammoth-elephant divergence rate?
Reanalysing the published mainland and Wrangel Island mammoth genomes, what signature of small population size did Rogers and Slatkin find, and what coat phenotype did they predict?

needle.sv: När dog de sista mammutarna på S:t Paul Island i Alaska ut, och vad pekar bevisen ut som orsak?
Vad visade myskoxens forntida DNA om människans roll i artens tillbakagång?

needle.en: What does the mitochondrial phylogeography of the American mastodon say about how the species used the far north during glacial cycles?
Grey wolves survived the Late Pleistocene extinctions, yet something wolf-shaped did go extinct in Beringia. What was it, and what evidence identified it?
The standard model derived Eurasian cave hyenas from multiple out-of-Africa migrations between 3.5 and 0.35 Ma. What did radiocarbon-dated Chinese specimens do to that model?

needle.sv: Varifrån kom de första europeiska mitogenomen från ullhårig noshörning, och vad visade de?
Hur gammalt var det brittiska uroxeprov som gav det första uroxgenomet, och vad avslöjade jämförelsen med moderna nötkreatur?

needle.en: Three Dinornis moa species were recognised on size grounds. What did the first sex-linked nuclear sequences from an extinct species show, and how extreme was the dimorphism?
Were New Zealand's moa already declining when Polynesians arrived? What does the genetic evidence say?
What is the empirically measured half-life of DNA in bone, and what are the conditions and caveats attached to that number?
What coverage and completeness did the 2024 little bush moa nuclear genome reach, and what did it settle about moa winglessness?
Ratite biogeography was long explained by Gondwanan vicariance. Which two lineages did mitogenomes of extinct elephant birds pair up, and what does that imply?

Australian megafaunal eggshell exploited by humans before 50 ka was attributed to Genyornis newtoni, then reattributed to a giant megapode — which would acquit humans of that extinction. How was the dispute resolved, and did ancient DNA settle it?
Was the great auk in trouble before humans started hunting it intensively, and what would hunting alone have been sufficient to do?

needle.sv: Var kom torsken i vikingatidens Haithabu ifrån, enligt forntida DNA?

needle.en: How did bowhead whales respond to the Pleistocene-Holocene transition, and what is the projection for their core habitat this century?
What does the 2004 Science review conclude about climate versus humans as the cause of the continental late Pleistocene extinctions?
Cooper et al. (2015) compared 31 megafaunal time series against Northern Hemisphere climate records. Which kind of climate event lined up with turnover — cold stadials or warming interstadials?
In Patagonia, humans arrived just before a cold phase. When did the megafaunal extinction actually happen there, and how does the sequence compare with North America?

In the 1989 study that first characterised DNA extracted from dry soft-tissue remains between 4 and 13,000 years old, what kinds of chemical damage were found, and why did that make molecular cloning a poor strategy?
Which three spontaneous chemical processes did Lindahl's 1993 Nature review identify as the main routes of DNA decay, and what did he conclude they imply for fossils?
What aspartic-acid D/L threshold did Poinar et al. (1996) propose as a screen for endogenous ancient DNA, and what did they find in the specimens said to yield million-year-old sequences?
What did the 2003 Science study of permafrost and cave sediments recover in the absence of any macrofossils?
What is 'thermal age' as used to rank fossil sites for ancient-DNA work, and what degradation mechanism does the ranking assume?
The Vindija G1 Neandertals were directly radiocarbon dated in 1998/1999 to about 28,000-29,000 14C years ago. What changed, and what does it show about dating specimens used for genetic work?

needle.sv: Hur visade man att DNA kan vandra nedåt mellan lagren i grottsediment, och vad betyder det för tolkningen av sediment-DNA?
Vad består den optimerade utvinningsmetoden för gammalt DNA från 2007 av, och vad hände med alla de extra tillsatser som brukade blandas i buffertarna?

needle.en: What two features of sequence data from a Neandertal, a mammoth and a cave bear did Briggs et al. (2007) use to infer the chemistry behind post-mortem damage?
What does treatment with uracil-DNA-glycosylase plus endonuclease VIII do to an ancient DNA extract, and what biological signal survived the treatment?
What rate of sample misidentification did double indexing reveal in single-indexed Illumina multiplex sequencing, and what was the dominant cause?
Can the mean fragment length of a library be used as a rough clock for how old a specimen is?
Why do default BWA settings mishandle ancient reads, and how much does tuning them recover?

needle.sv: Hur kunde man visa att mjölkhushållning fanns i Sahara redan under femte årtusendet f.Kr., utan vare sig ben eller arvsmassa att gå på?

needle.en: What made a 30-fold Denisovan genome possible from a single small bone, and what did that depth allow that a low-coverage genome cannot?
The figure 'the half-life of DNA is 521 years' is widely quoted as if it were a constant. What was actually measured, and under what conditions?
How was the mitochondrial molecular clock calibrated directly from ancient sequences rather than from fossils, and what bound did that give on the non-African separation?
Which four parameters of ancient DNA molecules does mapDamage 2.0 estimate, and what does it do with base quality scores?
Ancient DNA libraries are strikingly deficient in molecules shorter than 40 bp. Where is that material lost, and what did recovering it demonstrate about preservation?
How does a post-mortem degradation (PMD) score rescue a heavily contaminated specimen, and what was the demonstration case?

needle.sv: Vad är poängen med att bara delvis behandla ett gammalt DNA-bibliotek med uracil-DNA-glykosylas i stället för fullt ut?
Var i klippbenet sitter det bästa gamla DNA:t, och hur stor är skillnaden mot resten av benet?
Vilka två egenskaper hos fragmenten använder schmutzi för att skilja gammalt DNA från nutida, och hur mycket främmande DNA tål metoden?

needle.en: What does gargammel simulate, and why would you want simulated ancient reads at all?
How does the ssDNA2.0 protocol attach the first adapter without CircLigase, and what practical gains followed?
Is the petrous bone always the better sampling choice over tooth cementum?
What did targeted mitochondrial enrichment of cave sediments establish about hominin occupation?
How are peptides in tooth enamel used to determine the sex of a skeleton, and what does the method do that osteology and DNA cannot?

needle.sv: Hur låg täckning klarar READ när man vill bestämma släktskap mellan förhistoriska individer, och vad hittade upphovsmännen med metoden?

needle.en: Is index hopping confined to patterned flow cells with ExAmp chemistry?

needle.sv: Vilka två förbehandlingar av ben- och tandmjöl används för att bli av med främmande DNA, och vilken är effektivast?

needle.en: What did five years of negative controls reveal about contamination in an ultraclean ancient DNA laboratory, and what reporting standard did the authors recommend?
Why does reference bias hit ancient data harder than modern data, and which downstream analyses does it distort?
How old is the oldest RNA sequenced so far, and what evidence shows the transcripts are genuinely ancient rather than modern contamination?
What made the Gigantopithecus enamel proteome remarkable in preservation terms, and what phylogenetic question did it settle?
What does the HOPS pipeline add over ordinary metagenomic classification of archaeological samples?
Does genotype imputation remove reference bias in ultra-low-coverage ancient genomes?
Down to what coverage can contamination in male ancient genomes be estimated with hapCon, and what assumption bounds its validity?
What is the age of the oldest environmental DNA recovered so far, and what is the proposed reason it survived?
How do the 1240k reagent and the two commercial assays that replaced it compare, and how many rounds of enrichment are worth doing?
Besides identifying the species, what second piece of information can a ZooMS collagen peptide fingerprint provide, and what did the high-resolution version change in practice?
What coverage does ancIBD require, and what segment lengths can it call?
How can a dietary radiocarbon reservoir offset be corrected when the local freshwater reservoir effect is not independently constrained?
